Case study

Mercedes CLA45 Indoor Detailing Bay Hire

A professional detailer hired the Auto Opulence studio to complete a full exterior preparation and protection project on this black Mercedes CLA45. The car was washed with access to our indoor wash bay and spotless-water system, machine polished beneath dedicated detailing lights and ceramic coated without being moved outside. From summer heatwaves to heavy storms, the air-conditioned studio provides a dependable place to complete demanding work in controlled conditions.

View project
Case study

Audi TT Valet Bay Hire

This grey Audi TT visited the Auto Opulence detailing bay for a private preparation session before travelling to the Better Car Care open day. The owner brought their preferred Stjärnagloss cleaning products and used the purpose-built indoor space to work through the vehicle without weather interruptions. The finished paintwork, wheels and motorsport-inspired cabin were ready for the next day's event.

View project
Case study

Volvo XC60 End-of-Lease Valet

Auto Opulence collected this three-year-old Volvo XC60 for a thorough end-of-lease clean. Although its owner had looked after it carefully, grime had accumulated in hard-to-reach areas and within the boot carpet. After several focused hours of interior and exterior cleaning, plus the reduction of two surface scratches, the vehicle was transformed and returned directly to the customer with minimal disruption.

View project
Case study

BMW E21 3 Series Restoration Detail

This factory-original BMW E21 3 Series arrived with its original paint, glass, matching numbers and original dealer-supplied number plates. Although the 45-year-old car had clearly been cared for, decades of use had dulled its red paintwork and marked the light interior. Over 18 focused hours, Auto Opulence deep-cleaned the cabin, corrected the paint, detailed the engine bay and applied Gyeon ceramic protection while respecting the car's originality.

View project
Case study

Merl Grey Range Rover Sport

After receiving a considerably higher dealer quote for a less comprehensive product, the owner chose Auto Opulence for a full ceramic coating package, including the Range Rover Sport's large alloy wheels. The Merl Grey pearl paint was thoroughly decontaminated and prepared before Gyeon Evo ceramic protection was applied, creating a deep, lustrous glimmer while making future maintenance easier.
